    source_material_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    generation         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 0),
    request_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    applied_at         TEXT NOT NULL,

    source_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES study_materials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    scheduler_version  TEXT NOT NULL,
    step               INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (step BETWEEN -1 AND 7),
    due_at             TEXT,
    last_reviewed_at   TEXT,
    reps               INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reps >= 0),
    lapses             INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (lapses >= 0),
    suspended          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (suspended IN (0, 1)),
    flag               TEXT CHECK (flag IN ('wrong_answer', 'unclear', 'not_in_source')),
    revision           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1),
    CHECK ((due_at IS NULL) = (last_reviewed_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK (due_at IS NOT NULL OR (reps = 0 AND step = -1))
)

objects.name: trg_card_ops_material_delete
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_card_ops_material_delete
AFTER DELETE ON study_materials
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE card_review_operations
    SET is_erased = 1, result_json = NULL
    WHERE source_material_id = OLD.id AND is_erased = 0;
END

objects.name: trg_cleanup_material_delete
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cleanup_material_delete
AFTER DELETE ON study_materials
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE practice_session_operations
    SET is_erased = 1, result_json = 'null'
    WHERE attempt_id IN (SELECT id FROM practice_attempts
        WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND status IN ('in_progress', 'abandoned'));

    DELETE FROM practice_attempts
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND status IN ('in_progress', 'abandoned');

    UPDATE practice_test_versions
    SET is_active = 0
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND is_active = 1;

    DELETE FROM practice_test_versions
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL
      AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE status = 'completed');
END

objects.name: trg_enforce_response_item_version_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_enforce_response_item_version_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON practice_responses
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Item does not belong to attempt version')
    WHERE (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE id = NEW.attempt_id
    ) != (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_test_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id
    );
END

BEFORE UPDATE OF item_id, attempt_id ON practice_responses
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Item does not belong to attempt version')
    WHERE (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE id = NEW.attempt_id
    ) != (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_test_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id
    );
END

trg_card_ops_material_delete.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_card_ops_material_delete
AFTER DELETE ON study_materials
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE card_review_operations
    SET is_erased = 1, result_json = NULL
    WHERE source_material_id = OLD.id AND is_erased = 0;
END

trg_cleanup_material_delete.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cleanup_material_delete
AFTER DELETE ON study_materials
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE practice_session_operations
    SET is_erased = 1, result_json = 'null'
    WHERE attempt_id IN (SELECT id FROM practice_attempts
        WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND status IN ('in_progress', 'abandoned'));

    DELETE FROM practice_attempts
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND status IN ('in_progress', 'abandoned');

    UPDATE practice_test_versions
    SET is_active = 0
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL AND is_active = 1;

    DELETE FROM practice_test_versions
    WHERE source_material_id IS NULL
      AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE status = 'completed');
END

trg_enforce_response_item_version_insert.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_enforce_response_item_version_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON practice_responses
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Item does not belong to attempt version')
    WHERE (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE id = NEW.attempt_id
    ) != (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_test_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id
    );
END

trg_enforce_response_item_version_update.sql:

BEFORE UPDATE OF item_id, attempt_id ON practice_responses
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Item does not belong to attempt version')
    WHERE (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_attempts WHERE id = NEW.attempt_id
    ) != (
        SELECT version_id FROM practice_test_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id
    );
END
